verses.text: If you fully obey the LORD your God and carefully keep all his commands that I am giving you today, the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations on earth.
All these blessings will come to you and stay with you if you obey the LORD your God:
You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.
Your children will be blessed, and so will the crops of your land and the young of your animals, the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.
Your basket and your bread bowl will be blessed.
You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.
The LORD will make sure that the enemies who attack you are defeated in front of you. They will come at you from one direction but run from you in seven.
The LORD will send a blessing on your barns and on everything you do. The LORD your God will bless you in the land he is giving you.
The LORD will make you his holy people, as he promised you, if you keep the commands of the LORD your God and live the way he wants.
Then all the peoples on earth will see that you belong to the LORD, and they will be afraid of you.
The LORD will give you plenty of good things: many children, many young animals, and rich crops, in the land he promised your ancestors he would give you.

The LORD will open the heavens, his rich storehouse, to send rain on your land at the right time and to bless all the work of your hands. You will lend to many nations but will not need to borrow from any.

The LORD will make you the head and not the tail. You will always be on top and never at the bottom, if you listen to the commands of the LORD your God that I am giving you today and carefully obey them.
Do not turn away from any of the commands I am giving you today, to the right or to the left, to follow other gods and serve them.
But if you do not obey the LORD your God and do not carefully keep all his commands and rules that I am giving you today, all these curses will come on you and catch up with you:
You will be cursed in the city and cursed in the country.
Your basket and your bread bowl will be cursed.
Your children will be cursed, and so will the crops of your land, the calves of your herds, and the lambs of your flocks.
You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out.
The LORD will send on you curses, confusion, and failure in everything you try to do, until you are destroyed and quickly come to ruin, because of the evil you did in turning away from me.
The LORD will make deadly diseases cling to you until he has wiped you off the land you are going in to take over.
The LORD will strike you with wasting disease, with fever and swelling, with burning heat and drought, and with crops ruined by disease and mould. These will chase you until you are destroyed.
The sky over your head will be like bronze, and the ground under your feet like iron.
Instead of rain, the LORD will send down powder and dust on your land from the sky until you are destroyed.
The LORD will make sure that you are defeated by your enemies. You will come at them from one direction but run from them in seven. You will become a terrible sight to all the kingdoms on earth.
Your dead bodies will be food for all the birds and wild animals, and there will be no one to scare them away.
The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt, and with growths, sores, and itching that cannot be cured.
The LORD will strike you with madness, blindness, and confusion of mind.
At midday you will feel your way around like a blind person in the dark. You will not succeed in anything you do. Day after day you will be treated badly and robbed, and no one will rescue you.
You will be engaged to a woman, but another man will take her and sleep with her. You will build a house, but you will not live in it. You will plant a vineyard, but you will not enjoy its fruit.

Your ox will be killed in front of you, but you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be taken from you by force and will not be given back. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and no one will rescue them.
Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation, and you will wear out your eyes looking for them all day long, but you will be powerless to do anything.
A people you do not know will eat what your land produces and what you have worked hard for. All your life you will be treated badly and crushed.
The things you see will drive you mad.
The LORD will strike your knees and legs with painful boils that cannot be cured, spreading from the soles of your feet to the top of your head.
The LORD will send you and the king you set over you to a nation that neither you nor your ancestors have known. There you will worship other gods, gods made of wood and stone.
You will become a thing of horror, a joke, and an insult to all the nations where the LORD will send you.
You will plant much seed in the field but harvest little, because locusts will eat it.
You will plant vineyards and take care of them, but you will not drink the wine or gather the grapes, because worms will eat them.
You will have olive trees all over your land, but you will not use the oil, because the olives will drop off.
You will have sons and daughters, but you will not keep them, because they will be taken away as prisoners.
Swarms of locusts will take over all your trees and the crops of your land.
The foreigners who live among you will rise higher and higher above you, while you sink lower and lower.
They will lend to you, but you will not lend to them. They will be the head, and you will be the tail.
All these curses will come on you. They will chase you and catch up with you until you are destroyed, because you did not obey the LORD your God and keep the commands and rules he gave you.
These curses will be a sign and a warning to you and your descendants forever.
You did not serve the LORD your God joyfully and gladly when you had plenty of everything.
So you will serve the enemies the LORD sends against you. You will be hungry and thirsty, without clothes, and lacking everything. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.
The LORD will bring a nation against you from far away, from the ends of the earth, swooping down like an eagle. It will be a nation whose language you do not understand,
a fierce-looking nation that has no respect for the old and no pity for the young.
They will eat the young of your animals and the crops of your land until you are destroyed. They will leave you no grain, new wine, or olive oil, and no calves or lambs, until you are ruined.

They will surround and attack all your towns throughout your land, until the high, strong walls you trusted in fall down. They will attack all the towns throughout the land the LORD your God is giving you.
Because of the terrible suffering your enemy will bring on you during the attack, you will eat your own children, the flesh of the sons and daughters the LORD your God has given you.
Even the most gentle and kind man among you will have no pity on his own brother, the wife he loves, or the children he has left.

He will not give any of them a share of the flesh of his children that he is eating, because it will be all he has left, because of the terrible suffering your enemy will bring on you in all your towns.

The most gentle and delicate woman among you, so delicate that she would not even try to touch the ground with the sole of her foot, will have no pity on the husband she loves or on her own son or daughter.

She will secretly eat the afterbirth from her own body and the children she gives birth to, because she will have nothing else to eat. This will happen because of the terrible suffering your enemy will bring on you in your towns.
If you do not carefully obey all the words of this law written in this book, and do not fear this glorious and awesome name, the LORD your God,
then the LORD will send terrible disasters on you and your descendants: severe and lasting disasters, and terrible and lasting illnesses.
He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt that you were so afraid of, and they will cling to you.
The LORD will also bring on you every kind of sickness and disaster not written in this Book of the Law, until you are destroyed.
Though you were as many as the stars in the sky, only a few of you will be left, because you did not obey the LORD your God.
Just as it pleased the LORD to do good to you and make you grow in number, so it will please him to ruin you and destroy you. You will be pulled up out of the land you are going in to take over.

Then the LORD will scatter you among all the nations, from one end of the earth to the other. There you will worship other gods, gods of wood and stone, which neither you nor your ancestors have known.
Among those nations you will find no peace and no place to rest your feet. There the LORD will give you a worried heart, eyes tired from longing, and a hopeless spirit.
Your life will always be in danger. You will be filled with fear night and day, never sure that you will live.
In the morning you will say, "If only it were evening!" and in the evening, "If only it were morning!" because of the terror that fills your heart and the things you see with your eyes.

The LORD will send you back to Egypt in ships, on a journey I said you would never make again. There you will try to sell yourselves to your enemies as male and female slaves, but no one will buy you.
